capabilities: Answer follow-up questions using the note
extras: Desktop only; first launch creates a Python venv and installs a local sidecar from GitHub/PyPI. The API key is stored in ~/.socrates-pen/llm.json, not the vault. Deep-dive questions work best with the eight-beat handbook format; only deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash was tested. A practice system is in development and off by default.
motivation: The author built it after working through a 13,083-line handbook where the hard part was having nobody to ask when stuck.
problem: When working through a long handbook alone, there is no one who has read the book to ask at the point where you get stuck.

relations.evidence: the sidecar GETs DuckDuckGo's plain-HTML result page itself

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint API key

summary: Sidebar Socratic tutor that questions a highlighted passage, answers follow-ups from the note, and writes approved edits back.
